questions.no_power: Does the laptop fail to turn on at all (no lights, no fan sound)?
questions.charger_light_off: Is the charger/charging light off when plugged in?
questions.charger_light_on: Is the charger/charging light ON when plugged in?
questions.screen_black_power_on: Do the lights/fan come on but the screen stays black?
questions.external_monitor_also_black: Is an external monitor ALSO black when connected?
questions.external_monitor_works: Does an external monitor show the display correctly?
questions.slow_performance: Is the laptop very slow or freezing?
questions.disk_usage_high: Is disk usage near 100% in Task Manager?
questions.ram_usage_high: Is memory (RAM) usage above 90% in Task Manager?
questions.fan_loud_hot: Is the laptop very hot with a loud fan?
questions.wifi_not_connecting: Does this laptop fail to connect to WiFi?
questions.airplane_mode_on: Is airplane mode ON or the WiFi switch turned off?
questions.other_devices_wifi_ok: Do other devices (phone etc.) connect to the same WiFi fine?
questions.other_devices_also_fail: Do other devices ALSO fail to connect to that WiFi?
questions.battery_drains_fast: Does the battery drain much faster than it used to?
questions.battery_old: Is the battery more than 3 years old?
questions.no_sound: Is there no sound from the laptop speakers?
questions.muted_or_volume_zero: Is the volume muted or set to zero?
questions.usb_not_detected: Does the laptop fail to detect devices plugged into a USB port?
questions.other_usb_port_works: Does the same device work in a different USB port?
questions.device_fails_on_other_pc: Does the device also fail on another computer?

descriptions.power_supply_issue: Power supply problem (charger or charging port)
descriptions.battery_fault: Battery fault (charger works but laptop will not start)
descriptions.display_panel_fault: Display panel or cable fault (laptop works, screen does not)
descriptions.storage_bottleneck: Storage (disk) is the bottleneck causing slowness
descriptions.memory_shortage: Not enough RAM for the running programs
descriptions.overheating_issue: Overheating is slowing the laptop down
descriptions.wifi_switched_off: WiFi is switched off (airplane mode / WiFi switch)
descriptions.wifi_adapter_or_driver_issue: Laptop WiFi adapter or driver problem
descriptions.fix_replace_charger: FIX: Try another charger or inspect the charging port
descriptions.fix_replace_battery: FIX: Replace or reseat the battery; get it serviced
descriptions.fix_service_display: FIX: Get the display or its cable repaired
descriptions.fix_service_motherboard: FIX: Take it to a service centre for board/graphics repair
descriptions.fix_free_disk_or_ssd: FIX: Free up disk space, or upgrade to an SSD
descriptions.fix_close_apps_or_add_ram: FIX: Close heavy programs or add more RAM
descriptions.fix_clean_fan_repaste: FIX: Clean the fan and vents, replace thermal paste
descriptions.fix_turn_off_airplane_mode: FIX: Turn off airplane mode and switch WiFi on
descriptions.fix_update_wifi_driver: FIX: Update or reinstall the WiFi driver
descriptions.fix_restart_router_call_isp: FIX: Restart the router; call your internet provider
descriptions.battery_worn_out: Battery is worn out from age
descriptions.fix_replace_old_battery: FIX: Replace the battery with a new one
descriptions.volume_muted: Volume is muted or set too low
descriptions.fix_unmute_volume: FIX: Unmute the volume and raise it
descriptions.fix_service_speakers: FIX: Get the speakers repaired or use headphones
descriptions.usb_port_fault: Faulty USB port (the device works in another port)
descriptions.usb_device_fault: The USB device itself is faulty
descriptions.fix_use_other_port_or_repair: FIX: Use another port or get the port repaired
descriptions.fix_replace_usb_device: FIX: Try a different device or replace this one
